title: Malicious code in @secaudita10x/sec-test-a1 (npm)
description: The npm package '@secaudita10x/sec-test-a1' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the severity of the compromise, complete remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine.
